I'll assemble the Q3 2024 QTR draft as a structured filing package, including the deadline computation, exemption test, and a formal approval/attestation block.

```python
import pandas as pd, numpy as np

# ---------- 1. Q3 2024 reporting period & deadline ----------
q_start, q_end = pd.Timestamp("2024-07-01"), pd.Timestamp("2024-09-30")
due = pd.Timestamp(np.busday_offset(q_end.date(), 15, roll="forward"))  # 15 business days after

# ---------- 2. QTR data payload ----------
txn_volume = 45_230
txn_count  = 45_230
fx = {"USD": 12_450_300.00, "EUR": 3_210_450.75, "GBP": 980_200.10}

qtr = pd.DataFrame({
    "report_field": ["total transaction volume", "number of transactions"],
    "value": [f"{txn_volume:,}", f"{txn_count:,}"],
})
fx_df = pd.DataFrame({"currency": list(fx), "aggregate_value": list(fx.values())})

# ---------- 3. Exemption test (Rule 2024-07 §3.2) ----------
exempt = txn_volume < 10_000
filing_type = "Simplified QTR" if exempt else "Full QTR"

# ---------- 4. Output ----------
print("=== QTR DRAFT — NovaPay Ltd. ===")
print(f"Regulator        : Aurelia Financial Conduct Authority (AFCA)")
print(f"Rule             : 2024-07, Section 3.2")
print(f"Reporting period : {q_start.date()} to {q_end.date()} (Q3 2024)")
print(f"Filing deadline  : {due.date()} (15 business days after quarter end)")
print(f"Exemption test   : volume {txn_volume:,} >= 10,000  -> {filing_type} required")
print()
print("-- Count fields --")
print(qtr.to_string(index=False))
print()
print("-- Aggregate value by currency --")
print(fx_df.to_string(index=False))
print(f"\nLine count (currencies) : {len(fx_df)}")
print(f"Completeness: all 3 mandated elements present -> "
      f"{'YES' if len(qtr)==2 and len(fx_df)>0 else 'NO'}")
```
